name: IPTrust IP System API Schema
description: IPTrust exposes brands, IP taxonomy, brand architecture, project applications, assets and history through REST and MCP.

brandFields.slug: Stable IP ID / asset key used by URLs and agent calls.
brandFields.assetKey: Human-readable alias for slug in asset and agent contexts.
brandFields.name: Configured public/English name.
brandFields.mainLanguage: Main display language: zh or en.
brandFields.mainLocale: Public label for mainLanguage: CN or EN.
brandFields.officialWebsite: Official website URL, blank when unknown.
brandFields.display: Bilingual display names and secondary labels.
brandFields.profile: Callable business profile fields: officialWebsite, mainLanguage, intro, business, notes, classification.
brandFields.intro: Live bilingual intro generated from config or primary guideline.
brandFields.notes: Bilingual notes for public context, agent hints, or operational remarks.
brandFields.classification: Bilingual category arrays: tracks, audiences, and tags.
brandFields.theme: Brand colors, surface, ink, line, mode, and keywords.
brandFields.images: Image asset metadata and public site paths, including format, bytes, human-readable size, width, height, and dimensions.
brandFields.adobeAssets: Adobe source files, preview images, page exports, formats, file sizes, and public URLs.
brandFields.logoUrl: Canonical public URL path for the preferred IP logo, blank when no verified logo asset exists.
brandFields.assetKit: Unified callable IP asset endpoints, colors, images, and moodboard source.
brandFields.moodboard: Derived colors, keywords, and image assets for visual direction.
brandFields.editablePaths: Source files editable from admin flow.
brandFields.source: GitHub source folder and local folder.
brandFields.sources: Public provenance records with publisher, URL, verification date, and confidence.
brandFields.primaryIndustry: Primary term from the controlled bilingual industry taxonomy.
brandFields.industries: One or more controlled industry taxonomy terms.
brandFields.ipType: Controlled single IP type; parent/child status is represented by relationships.
brandFields.lifecycleStatus: Lifecycle state such as active, draft, archived or retired.
brandFields.parentCapable: Whether the IP is explicitly available as a mother IP even before children are linked.
brandFields.architectureRoles: Computed roles; an IP can be parent, child, both, or standalone.

architecture.primaryParent: One optional brand_parent relationship; cycles are rejected.
architecture.applications: Stores, properties, deployments, events, content series, digital products and collaborations remain applications rather than independent IPs.
architecture.inheritance: An application inherits its primary IP guideline and stores local changes in overrides.

versioning.model: Git-backed history. Source edits flow through repository commits, then build into website JSON.
